name: gst-registration-checker
description: Biz Matrix GST Registration Checker: is GST registration required, State-wise limit, route, documents and PDF report.

scripts.prebuild: npm run rules:lint && npm run rules:build
scripts.qa: npm run rules:lint && npm run rules:build && npm run typecheck && vitest run && npm run report:coverage && npm run report:stale && npm run report:verification && npm run docs:review-pack && npm run samples:pdf
scripts.build:site: npm run rules:lint && npm run rules:build && tsc --noEmit && vite build --outDir ../gst-registration-checker --emptyOutDir
